source_row.rationale: 42 CFR 482.13 requires restraint or seclusion for violent or self-destructive behavior to be ordered by an authorized practitioner and limits renewal periods by age. For adults age 18 or older, an order may be renewed up to 4 hours at a time, subject to the regulation's reassessment, monitoring, face-to-face evaluation, discontinuation, and state-law requirements. Standing or PRN restraint orders are not permitted.
source_row.source_detail: §482.13(e), restraint/seclusion: no standing or PRN orders; violent/self-destructive behavior renewal limits include 4 hours for adults age 18 or older, with continued monitoring and reassessment requirements.

source_row.stem: A hospital uses a restraint for violent or self-destructive behavior in an adult. Which statement about the order is accurate under the federal hospital Conditions of Participation?
